LESSON: THE ENLIGHTENED BEINGS INTRODUCTORY STORIES

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: HINDU RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: Manifestations
Topic 3.1: The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate the qualities of Enlightened Beings to strengthen faith in Paramatma. Enlightened Beings 3.2 Religious Symbols (6 lessons) particular faith.
2. appreciate the significance of religious symbols in religious life. 105 significance of the above mentioned religious symbols. and color religious symbols.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. appreciate the qualities of Enlightened Beings to strengthen faith in Paramatma. Enlightened Beings 3.2 Religious Symbols (6 lessons) particular faith.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the qualities of Enlightened Beings to strengthen faith in Paramatma. Enlightened Beings 3.2 Religious Symbols (6 lessons) particular faith. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. appreciate the significance of religious symbols in religious life. 105 significance of the above mentioned religious symbols. and color religious symbols.
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the significance of religious symbols in religious life. 105 significance of the above mentioned religious symbols. and color religious symbols. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Name one place of worship in your community and say how people show respect there.

Example 2: Practise sitting quietly for a short prayer or reflection.

Example 3: Tell your parent one good habit you learned from this lesson.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories.
2. Explain The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories.
4. Show that you can: appreciate the qualities of Enlightened Beings to strengthen faith in Paramatma. Enlightened Beings 3.2 Religious Symbols (6 lessons) particular faith.
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is The Enlightened Beings Introductory stories important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. appreciate the qualities of Enlightened Beings to strengthen faith in Paramatma. Enlightened Beings 3.2 Religious Symbols (6 lessons) particular faith.
2. appreciate the significance of religious symbols in religious life. 105 significance of the above mentioned religious symbols. and color religious symbols.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.
